rules.matches: [text="打开通知"] + [text*="打开 Telegram 的通知"]

groups.name: 局部广告-顶部横幅提示
groups.desc: 此规则覆盖生日提示、拍卖提示以及部分广告

rules.matches: @ImageView[desc=null][clickable=true][width<140 && height<140] - LinearLayout >2 TextView[text*="生日" || text*="birthday" || text$="!" || text$="."][text.length>10]
@[text="Not now" || text^="稍后"] < [childCount=2] - ScrollView >2 [text*="contacts" || text*="联系人"][text.length>20]

groups.name: 功能类-更多-保存到相册
groups.desc: 右上角菜单-点击[保存到相册]

rules.matches: @[clickable=true][left>350] > [text="保存到相册" || text="儲存到相簿" || text="Save to Gallery"]

groups.name: 功能类-只保存单个媒体
groups.desc: 弹窗-点击 [这张图片]或[该媒体]

rules.matches: [text^="保存" || text^="儲存" || text^="Save"] < * +2 * > [text^="这" || text^="這" || text^="This" || text^="该"][clickable=true]
